social.author: Hulk Smash Szn
social.text: 5% to 43% and the game hasn't even scored a point?? Something just happened and I'm choosing to believe it's good. Let's GO No Banner only HULK

social.author: Dawgs Kennel Club
social.text: Kai's win chance just got mugged in broad daylight at 0-0. Someone check the Dawgs' pulse.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: No Banner only HULK jumping from 5% to 43% before a single point is a big lineup-status swing. Still short of a coin flip, but the model just stopped laughing.

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: Worth watching the No Banner only HULK vs Dawgs game closely. A swing that size at 0-0 usually means something changed in who's active.
